verdict.rationale: Slack documents a broad programmatic surface: a Web API for querying and changing workspace state with 200+ methods, an official OpenAPI spec, the Events API, and an official MCP server covering messages, files, canvases, lists and users. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows UI parity, though, and several UI features have no documented API equivalent: huddles, AI recaps and summaries, Slackbot, and no-code Workflow Builder authoring. missing for 10: an explicit parity commitment or API coverage of huddles, AI summaries/Slackbot and workflow authoring, plus independent hands-on confirmation that UI actions are reproducible via API.
